decision_rule.EXPLAINS: undistorted Omega focal bias < 5% AND median paired ratio (Omega ATE/path)/(VGGT ATE/path) <= 1.05 on desk AND on desk2
decision_rule.DOES NOT EXPLAIN: undistorted Omega focal bias > 8% OR median paired ratio >= 1.2 on desk AND on desk2
decision_rule.focal_bias: |mean over full submaps of (fx/width) / (fx_new/640) - 1|, pooled over desk, desk2, room
decision_rule.ratio: median over paired full submaps of (Omega ATE/path) / (VGGT ATE/path), per sequence

robustness_rotations_projected_to_SO3.note: same rule with ATE/path recomputed from camera centres built from SO(3)-projected rotations (VGGT's decoded rotations are not orthonormal); focal unchanged
